plugins.name: Music Visualizer
plugins.description: Spectrum, scope, waveform, radial, particles and pitch visuals for audio-only files. Pick a mode with the dropdown or V.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Skip Intro & Credits
plugins.description: Shows a Skip button during intros and credits found in chapter names (Intro, Opening, OP, Credits, Ending, ED) or set per show. Can skip automatically.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Lyrics
plugins.description: Synced lyrics as a karaoke overlay or a full-screen karaoke view with word-by-word highlight (enhanced LRC). Sources: a .lrc file next to the song, embedded tags (USLT/SYLT/LYRICS), cache, LRCLIB (plain lyrics as fallback) and a manual search. Per-track timing offset; save as .lrc or embed. Radio streams: lyrics for the current stream title.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Full-screen karaoke view (L / side panel) with word-level highlight for enhanced LRC, smooth scrolling and dimmed past/next lines; per-track timing offset ([ / ] ±0.1 s, Shift ±0.5 s); Find Lyrics dialog (Ctrl+L: edit artist/title, results with duration and synced/plain); embedded lyrics (USLT/SYLT/LYRICS/©lyr) and LRCLIB plain lyrics as sources; save as .lrc or embed in tags.

plugins.name: Subtitle Search
plugins.description: Find subtitles on OpenSubtitles (by file hash, name or IMDb id) in the Add Subtitles dialog, and keep a subtitle offset per file (z / x).
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Hash search first (Exact match badge), then by name or IMDb id; multi-language chips (remembered); results with downloads, rating, FPS, hearing-impaired, trusted and machine-translation badges; details and text preview; one-click Load; pick remembered per file; optional save next to the video; per-file subtitle offset (z / x ±0.1 s, Shift ±1 s, side panel) with Auto-sync via the Subtitle Auto-Sync plugin.

plugins.name: Auto-tagger
plugins.description: Identifies songs by their audio (AcoustID fingerprint, system fpcalc first) or tags, merges MusicBrainz, Deezer, iTunes, Last.fm and Discogs ranked by confidence, and writes tags, hi-res covers and optional LRCLIB lyrics after a preview: per-field source badges, switch to another source's value, cover candidates, synced/plain lyrics, opt-in safe rename from a pattern. Batch folders, backups and Undo. Keys optional.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Merged sources ranked by match confidence (agreeing sources raise it, duplicates collapse); per-field alternatives from other sources (⇄); lyrics rows show LRCLIB synced vs plain; file card notes fingerprinter and sources; fingerprint matches suggest a file name from a pattern (opt-in, never overwrites, sanitized); batch progress with matched/skipped counts; keys also from VIVI_ACOUSTID_KEY / VIVI_LASTFM_KEY / VIVI_DISCOGS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: Free Music
plugins.description: Search and browse Creative Commons and public-domain music from Jamendo, the Internet Archive and the Free Music Archive in one list with source badges: genres, moods, licence filters (commercial use, CC BY, BY-SA, CC0), sort, infinite scroll, album and artist pages, play similar, and downloads with tags, cover and licence attribution. Jamendo needs a free client ID.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Network Streams
plugins.description: Internet radio (radio-browser.info, SomaFM), iptv-org TV by country and category, your own M3U/IPTV playlists that refresh themselves, favorites, group and category chips, channel logos, an XMLTV program guide (now / next) and stream info. No key needed; nothing bundled, everything fetched and cached on demand.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: XMLTV program guide (now / next from the playlist url-tvg or a guide URL setting; only 12 hours kept), favorites pinned on top, group-title chips and iptv-org category chips, My playlists (custom M3U URLs that refresh themselves, last updated, broken links keep the last good copy), Search all (TV + radio), Add to queue and Mini player actions, broken logos remembered and a 64 MB logo cache cap.

plugins.name: Now Playing OSD
plugins.description: Example mpv Lua script: shows the title on the OSD when a file starts.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: A-B Loop & Frame Step
plugins.description: Set and clear A-B loop points from the keyboard, nudge them by a frame, step frame by frame while paused and see the loop on an on-screen bar.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Requires Vivi 0.9.0 (managed ffmpeg support).
Shows confirmations as Vivi toasts.
First release: A-B loop points, frame nudging and stepping, on-screen loop bar.

plugins.name: AcoustID Tagger
plugins.description: Identifies the playing song by its sound: fingerprints it with Chromaprint's fpcalc, looks it up on AcoustID and MusicBrainz and opens the Auto-tagger's before/after review with the tags and a new file name built from your pattern (for example {artist} - {title}), applied only when you confirm. Uses an installed fpcalc, otherwise downloads the official one (1.3–2.6 MB). Needs your free AcoustID application key.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Download fpcalc when it is not installed

changelog.notes: First release: fpcalc fingerprint (system or downloaded), AcoustID + MusicBrainz lookup into the Auto-tagger review, file name proposal from a pattern.

plugins.name: Chapter Thumbnails
plugins.description: Thumbnail preview while hovering the seek bar and a picture for every chapter in the Chapters tab, generated in the background (on the first hover, or when the video opens) and cached per file. Alt+H lists the chapters with titles and times. Uses your ffmpeg; without one it downloads Vivi's media ffmpeg build once (about 15 MB, shared with Subtitle Auto-Sync).
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.label: Generate

settings.title: Delete the cached thumbnails of this file
settings.label: Clear

changelog.notes: Auto frame count (one per 10 s, 25 to 200) and a choice of when seek-bar previews are made: on the first hover (default) or after 10 s of playback at low priority; coarse-to-fine, so previews appear within a second. Cache size limit in MB and Clear all. Fixes: changing the frame count no longer mixes old and new frames, chapter pictures follow chapters added or moved later (SponsorBlock, Scene Chapters), no lost chapter updates while busy, AV1 and other codecs the bundled ffmpeg can't decode are reported. README rewritten; screenshots.
Downloads the ffmpeg helper from the Loafer19/vivi-plugins releases (same build and checksums).
First release: seek-bar hover thumbnails and chapter thumbnails cached per file, chapter list on Alt+H, system ffmpeg or Vivi's media build.

plugins.name: Cut & Export Clip
plugins.description: Cut a fragment of the current file into a new file: set In / Out (Alt+[ / Alt+]) or reuse the A-B loop points, then export (Alt+W) by fast lossless stream copy or a frame-accurate re-encode. Uses your ffmpeg; without one it downloads Vivi's media ffmpeg build once (about 15 MB, shared with Chapter Thumbnails and Subtitle Auto-Sync; it re-encodes audio only, video re-encoding needs a system ffmpeg).

plugins.name: Discord Rich Presence
plugins.description: Shows the current title, artist and progress in your Discord status. Needs a Discord application ID; Discord must be running on this computer. Ships a small native helper (vivi-discord) that talks to Discord's local IPC.
plugins.author: Vivi

Large image key (optional art asset of your Discord application)

changelog.notes: First release as a downloadable plugin with the native vivi-discord helper (moved out of the core).

plugins.name: Equalizer
plugins.description: Deprecated: built into Vivi since 0.13.0 (Audio panel → Equalizer). Equalizer presets (Bass, Vocal, Rock, Night, Flat) and a custom 10-band EQ from 31 Hz to 16 kHz, through mpv's audio filters (ffmpeg equalizer or superequalizer). Alt+E cycles presets, Alt+Shift+E turns it off; the choice is remembered. Independent of the Audio panel's own EQ.

changelog.notes: Deprecated: the built-in Equalizer in Vivi 0.13.0 (Audio panel) replaces this plugin, with Bass, Vocal, Rock and Night presets, Alt+E / Alt+Shift+E and an auto pre-amp. Nothing else changed.
First release: Flat, Bass, Vocal, Rock and Night presets, custom 10-band EQ (equalizer or superequalizer), anti-clipping pre-amp, remembered across restarts.

deprecated.message: The built-in Equalizer (player side panel → Audio) replaces this plugin since Vivi 0.13.0, with the same presets, Alt+E / Alt+Shift+E and the anti-clipping pre-amp. You can uninstall the plugin.

plugins.name: Night Mode
plugins.description: Compresses loud scenes and lifts quiet dialogue so films stay understandable at low volume (mpv dynaudnorm / loudnorm). Toggle with Alt+N, turn it on by schedule (e.g. 22:00-07:00) or only for videos.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Night mode on (at startup when no schedule is set)
Only for videos (leave music and audio-only files untouched)

changelog.notes: Schedule (e.g. 22:00-07:00): turns on and off by time of day, Alt+N still overrides. Only for videos: leaves music and audio-only files untouched. README: requires Vivi 0.9.0 (not 0.8.0); new screenshots.
Requires Vivi 0.9.0 (managed ffmpeg support).
Shows confirmations as Vivi toasts.
Reports the strength when it is changed while Night Mode is off.
First release.

plugins.name: Offline Downloads
plugins.description: A download queue for offline listening and watching: YouTube and other yt-dlp sites, direct music files (Jamendo, Internet Archive and any audio/video link) and radio streams recorded for a set time. Pending / active / paused / done / failed list with pause, cancel and retry, progress and a download folder. Paste a URL or press Alt+D with one in the clipboard. Downloads no tools of its own: it uses curl and your yt-dlp, or the copy the YouTube & yt-dlp plugin manages.

Vivi 0.13+: the queue shows in the shared Downloads panel (Library → Downloads) with per-download Pause / Resume, Cancel and Retry; the panel's paste-a-link field and its Download / record button add to this queue; Show and Alt+Shift+D open the panel. Older Vivi keeps the on-screen queue.
First release: queue with pause / cancel / retry for yt-dlp sites, direct files and radio recordings.

plugins.name: Playback Statistics
plugins.description: Counts time watched and listened per day, with top artists and shows. Kept locally in a small TSV file; Alt+S shows a summary, export as CSV or clear any time.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Requires Vivi 0.9.0 (managed ffmpeg support).
Shows confirmations as Vivi toasts.
First release.

plugins.name: Remote Control
plugins.description: Control Vivi from your phone: a dark, touch-friendly web page with cover art, seek, play/pause/next, volume and mute, speed, audio and subtitle tracks, chapters, the queue, library search, fullscreen and open URL, updated live. Pair by scanning a QR code; PIN protected and local-network only by default. Installs to the home screen. Ships a small native helper (vivi-remote) that serves the page.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: PIN (empty: a random 6-digit PIN is made)
Only devices on the local network (recommended)
Pair a phone: QR code, address and PIN
settings.label: Show QR code

changelog.notes: Redesigned phone page in Vivi's style (dark, orange accent, Inter, Lucide icons, big touch targets; phone portrait/landscape and tablet layouts). New: live updates, mute, speed, audio/subtitle track picker, chapters, queue remove, library search (with Settings → General → Remote control), fullscreen, open URL, add to home screen (web app manifest and icon). Pair by QR code (Show QR code; the QR dialog and fullscreen need Vivi 0.10.1+, older versions show a toast), New PIN action, Local network only setting; the PIN is no longer put in URLs and DNS-rebinding requests are refused. Fixes: quotes around the address in the toast, a stale cover after switching files, cover art for files that were still loading, queue names without file extensions, sizes in the catalog include the helper.
First release as a downloadable plugin with a native helper (moved out of the core).

plugins.name: Subtitle Auto-Sync
plugins.description: Aligns the current external subtitle to the audio with alass or ffsubsync in the background, then loads the synced copy saved next to the original. Manual offset keys (Alt+Z / Alt+X) are remembered per file (by Vivi itself from 0.11, together with z / x and the side panel). Uses an installed alass or ffsubsync; otherwise downloads alass on first use (3 MB on Linux x86_64, 26 MB on Windows) and, without a system ffmpeg, Vivi's media ffmpeg build (about 15 MB, shared with Chapter Thumbnails).
